name: Nodal Red 2X
description: Clavia Nord Lead 2X emulator (Gearmulator Nodal Red 2x): 4 slots, 20 voices, morphing
author: dsp56300/gearmulator (Pung module: rgeissen)

assets.label: ROM
assets.description: Requires a Nord Lead 2X firmware: one .bin file of 524,288 bytes (a dump of the synth's flash). The loader finds it by size and content, so the name is free.
assets.hint: The emulator runs two DSPs and a 68k at 98.2 kHz on its own threads, off the audio thread.

assets.label: Banks
assets.description: Program and performance banks as SysEx files (.syx). Each file becomes a bank in SOUNDS. The Nord stores no names: a .txt file with the bank file's name gives its sounds names, one a line. The emulated synth has no sounds of its own.
